summary: Verified fix for 'Join Demo Group' 404 bug. All demo endpoints working correctly. Backend returns 200 for valid demo invite link. Frontend /demo page renders correctly with all data. Navigation to invite page works (redirects to auth as expected).
passed_tests: GET /api/demo/group returns 200 with correct group data (Weekend Squad, San Francisco)
GET /api/demo/group returns 5 members (Alex, Jordan, Sam, Riley, New Member)
GET /api/demo/group includes current_plan with activity, location, suggested_time, explanation
/demo page loads correctly with demo group data
/demo page displays all 5 members with interests
/demo page shows completed plan (Golden Gate Park Picnic)
/demo page shows Moments section with images
'Join Demo Group' button exists with data-testid='join-demo-group-button'
'Join Demo Group' button is visible and clickable
Invite page correctly redirects to Google Auth (expected behavior for auth-gated page)
critical_code_review_comments: Demo data auto-seeding on startup working correctly (ensure_demo_data helper)
Error handling in Demo.js includes retry and fallback UI
InvitePreferences.js has proper error states with 'Try again' and 'Go to homepage' buttons
All data-testid attributes present for testing
seed_data_creation: Demo data auto-seeded by backend on startup (demo_group_showcase with 5 members)
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 404 bug for 'Join Demo Group' has been fixed. Backend seeds demo data on startup and has ensure_demo_data() helper that re-seeds if missing. Demo endpoints are public (no auth). Invite page requires Google Auth - after auth, it shows preferences form or error state. All tests passing.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 404 was caused by demo data not being seeded in MongoDB. Fix: Backend startup now seeds demo group via migrate_existing_groups() and ensure_demo_data() helper re-seeds if data is missing. Frontend now uses React Router navigate() instead of window.location.href for smoother navigation.
